'''Third Anthology''' is the 24th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 14 June 2000. It is six black-border premium cards (5 Light Side, 1 Dark Side) in an 800-card storage box, plus two Premiere Unlimited packs, two Special Edition starters (one per side), two [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] packs, and a card checklist. MSRP $34.95. CardGuide numbering: 24th product.

The randomized packs and starters are reprints and are not listed. The six premiums are unique to this box.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>
